With so few warps, the scheduler has nothing to hide latency behind: 73% of cycles have zero eligible warps. On Hopper (H200), replacing scalar pointer arithmetic with tl.make_block_ptr + tl.load enables the TMA hardware unit to handle address generation asynchronously, freeing SM cycles. Combined with @triton.autotune exploring smaller BLOCK_M (64) and more num_stages (3-4) for software pipelining, this reduces register pressure, increases occupancy, and hides memory latency.
